accepted.s: Which one of the following was a key recommendation of the Committee on the Financial System chaired by M. Narasimham in 1991?
o: Creation of a single universal bank by merging all public sector banks
Introduction of prudential norms and capital adequacy requirements
Increase in statutory liquidity ratio and cash reserve ratio
Complete nationalisation of private sector banks
accepted.x: The Narasimham-I Committee recommended prudential norms, capital adequacy, reduction of SLR and CRR, and deregulation of interest rates.
accepted.tq: Identify the committee by its distinctive reform recommendations rather than by its name alone.
accepted.sec: Banking and financial sector reform committees - official name + year + chair

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Narasimham-I and Narasimham-II Committees:
1. Narasimham-I recommended reduction of SLR and CRR.
2. Narasimham-II recommended a three-tier banking structure.
3. Narasimham-II proposed that weak and unviable banks should be closed.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Narasimham-I focused on foundational banking reforms, while Narasimham-II emphasised consolidation, a three-tier structure and resolution of weak banks.
accepted.tq: Test the different recommendations of two similarly named committees through statement combination.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the three-tier banking structure suggested by the Narasimham-II Committee?

One international bank, five national banks and several regional banks
Only regional rural banks, cooperative banks and payment banks
accepted.x: The proposed structure consisted of two or three international banks, eight to ten national banks and many local banks.
